The four-by-two actual residue audit shows (delta_s,epsilon*eta_s/p)=1 on every candidate class, so the quadratic norm supplies no splitting exclusion. Qualitative P-recursiveness, exponential height, nonvanishing, and the same norm shape still cannot improve the raw fixed-j=1 ceiling: for fixed K>=7, P_s^(K)=product_(k=7..K) binomial(k*s,s) is a positive first-order hypergeometric sequence of exponential height, every prime 6s<p<=Ks divides it, and its exact fixed-M admissible mass is ((K-6)/(2(3K-2)))M+o(M), tending to M/6. This is only an information-class no-go; the exact annihilator coefficients, actual factor localization, and W_D(M)=o(M) remain open. Booking is zero and the retained ceiling remains 1/36 per 6M.
